items.value: A stripped-down design with LED display screen, but the watch has multiple functions:Dual time,stopwatch,countdown,date,day,week,daily alarm ,luminous,12/24 hour,EL backlight,easy to read the time at night.

items.value: High transparent resin case and super soft silicone strap,comfortable to wear.It’s a ideal watch for those who like doing sports, shock resistant, stop watch, military 24H time mode, 50 M water resist and LED back light functions make it perfect for all kind of outdoors or indoors sport and daily use.

items.label: Comfortable Wrist Watch
items.value: Unlike similar products on the market, this silicone watch was designed having in mind improved functionality and comfort, enjoying a lightweight and ergonomic shape with easily accessible buttons and a user-friendly interface!

items.label: 5ATM Waterproof
items.value: 164Ft / 50M waterproof, In general,suitable for swimming in shallow water and cold showering, but keep away from hot water and steam, not suitable for long time underwater activities such as diving.(Please DO NOT PRESS the button under water.)
